description_en: A suspended egg-shaped woven chair attached by a plain chain to a curved freestanding metal-and-bamboo stand; the front shows the seat opening, the side reveals the suspension clearance and curved support, and the rear shows the shell ribs and broad stabilizing stand base. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
